Description: A person who is enrolled in an educational institution.
One who instructs or educates others.
An individual responsible for the operational, managerial, or administrative oversight of an educational institution or program.
A mother or a father; an immediate progenitor.
A courtesy title for a teacher of the highest academic rank in a college or university.
The broad general public, without restriction to a specific educational role, age group, or professional background.
Different than the one(s) previously specified or mentioned.
